notice: Staged import of the official 1404 ابنیه price book. Complete machine-readable extraction of every printed price row (chapters 1-14 and 16-28, Appendix 1 Table 2, Appendix 5), decoded at glyph level from the official PDF and validated against the verified specification (sections 11.5 and 11.6 and the Phase 3.5 chapter blocks). The 59 previously verified rows are preserved unchanged apart from the now-verified sourceFileHash. Chapter 15 is absent from the source; Chapter 29 prints no rows; row 030905 prints neither unit nor price and is documented in COVERAGE-1404.md instead of being given an invented unit. Blank cells stay null (INCOMPLETE), never zero; deduction and percentage cells follow the verified specification statements; no value is inferred from any neighbouring row.
